summary_1line: Sumali urges Ravana to reclaim Lanka from his brother Kubera; Ravana sends a demand, and Kubera, advised by their father, prepares to yield the city.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana stands on Trikuta Mountain overlooking the distant golden city of Lanka while sending Prahasta as his envoy.
Prahasta delivers Ravana’s message in the jeweled court of Kubera, the Lord of Wealth seated amid treasures of Lanka.
Kubera stands respectfully before the sage Vishravas with folded hands as his father warns him about Ravana’s dangerous pride.
